evidence.locator: text: opening grant ("FREE FOR COMMERCIAL AND NON-COMMERCIAL USE" and "Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted") together with the final no-relicensing term ("licence and distribution terms ... cannot be changed") identifies a nonstandard BSD-style family

text: final paragraph ("licence and distribution terms for any publically available version or derivative of this code cannot be changed" and the prohibition on putting it under another distribution licence) applies a no-relicensing constraint to the publicly available derivative as a whole; no separate library, linking, or network scope is stated

text: commercial/non-commercial sentence and opening grant ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted"); no purpose or field-of-use limitation is stated

text: attribution paragraph (copyright notices in code are not to be removed and Systemics should be attributed in product startup text or documentation); conditions 1-2 (source redistributions retain, and binary redistributions reproduce, the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer); condition 3 (advertising materials must display the fixed Systemics acknowledgement); final paragraph prohibits changing the licence/distribution terms

text: conditions 1-2 (source or binary redistribution activates notice-retention/reproduction duties), condition 3 (advertising materials mentioning features or use activate a fixed acknowledgement duty, represented by unknown because advertising is not a vocabulary trigger), and final paragraph (a public derivative activates the no-relicensing condition); modification alone has no separate notice duty

text: final paragraph (licence and distribution terms for a public version or derivative cannot be changed and the code cannot be put under another distribution licence) is an additional-term restriction; warranty paragraph disclaims express/implied warranties and limits liability for listed damages; no endorsement/name restriction is stated

text: complete license text (opening grant, conditions 1-3, disclaimer, and final no-relicensing paragraph); no express patent grant, patent condition, patent-claim restriction, or patent-termination clause is stated

text: attribution paragraph requires keeping Systemics copyright notices and giving product attribution in startup text or documentation; conditions 1-2 require source/binary notice and disclaimer retention/reproduction; condition 3 requires a fixed acknowledgement in advertising materials, creating a material multi-surface notice burden
